notes.title: Update 20250603
notes.content:
Corrected two outstanding bugs:

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where Client fails to connect to Host when launching match (outstanding PVP issue)
[*] Fixed issue where game was incorrectly scaling full screen setting (outstanding resolution issue)
[/list]

notes.title: Update 20250529
notes.content:
I want to extend a huge thank you to everyone who has downloaded and played our demo this week! We're elated that so many people have either clicked that Download Demo button or have wish listed our game. We're digging into the feedback we've received and are evaluating changes to make JUNK! more fun for new players, and to correct a small list of bugs that have been encountered.

Improvements:
[olist]
[*] Reduced Level Requirements for most abilities (improving experience and reducing 'grind')
[*] Updated feedback form
[*] Added Discord Button to main menu UI
[*] Updated credits
[/olist]

Known Bugs:
[olist]
[*] PVP has issues where match is not accurately closed on back end, causing crashes when joining new matches (since the old match still 'exists'). We're reviewing networking code and extensively testing to solve this problem
[*] Significant display resolution issue when launching app on SteamDeck, currently researching a solution
[/olist]
